caption: The drawing features a symmetrical, stylized object on a plain light background. At the center is a vertically oriented shape with a brown, textured trunk-like appearance and a yellow, teardrop-shaped pattern sectioned off in three areas by green bands. The middle of this trunk is decorated with circular orange and black motifs. Four zigzag, arrow-shaped elements with brown, red, and yellow coloring extend diagonally from the central form, and four blue, segmented elements with yellow highlights emerge from the central vertical shape near these arrows. Additionally, two blue wings with orange and brown at their base extend horizontally from the center. The design utilizes a limited color palette of brown, blue, yellow, orange, green, and black, with the composition arranged symmetrically around the central vertical axis. The drawing has no additional background elements or textures.
title: Ceiling Ornament
